title: Sheet-metal bend sequence optimization
summary: Return a feasible press-brake bend order — outermost first, springback-compensated, with a one-line rationale per step.
details:
## What's New

- **`vcad-kernel-sheet::sequence::bend_sequence`** kernel function: outside-in BFS over the bend tree, ties broken by id for determinism. Each step carries angle, radius, hinge length, the brake-compensated angle (target + springback) and a one-line rationale (hem first, jog members together, root-adjacent last).
- **`sheetMetalSequence` WASM binding** + engine helper + `Engine.sheetMetalSequence(doc)` method.
- **`sheet_metal_sequence` MCP tool**: agents and shop UIs get the form order directly.
